paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 7.4 as of July 24, 2026, with a 17.09 percent change from the prior close and a -15.91 percent change over a 21-session window. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a headline from Stocktwits on July 25, 2026, where Fermi Cofounder Toby Neugebauer stated that the market clearly wants cooperation between him and the company's board, as Fermi shares surged to over a 3-month high.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings.
